title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Ditto 151 132/165 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Ditto Holo 132/165 SV2a Pokemon 151 Japanese Pokemon Card is a must-have for any serious collector of Pokemon TCG cards. With its stunning holo finish and Japanese language, this card is a true gem in any collection.

Featuring the abnormal and beast-like Ditto character, this card is a standard size and belongs to the Pokemon TCG game. It is manufactured by Nintendo in Japan and is part of the 151 set. The card is colorless, holo rare, and has a chase feature. It is suitable for ages 6+ and is perfect for anyone who loves collecting Pokemon TCG cards.
